implementation_scope.presentation: Opt-in first-person removed and replacement magazine roles using existing geometry
implementation_scope.construction_bound: At most twelve cloned magazine part objects plus cached map, rigid-group and pose/contact state; source-inspection bound, not a measured heap profile.
implementation_scope.preservation: No ammunition, contact-event, simulator RNG, native media or packed Blender-source changes. Actor exchange remains opt-out; fallback/operator cache keys now include magazine and ammunition type.

package_observations.evidence_source: Static file sizes, normal release output and Git diff/source review; no runtime profile or asset audit.

verification.packaging_result: Validated JavaScript modules, geometry winding, local assets and Home Screen manifest.
verification.coverage_limit: Existing core checks do not establish correctness, visibility or natural motion of every exchange path.

not_performed: Additional or retired test suites, browser checks, shader checks, asset audits and profiles
Actual native/fallback gameplay image and professional animation acceptance
Physical iPhone performance, memory and thermal acceptance
remaining_limits: Rigid hands, no physical world-magazine inventory/collision/landing sounds, no third-person replacement exchange, and unverified path clipping/pop visibility, subjective quality and physical-device cost.
